styles.name: Bas-Relief
styles.description: Low, sculpted projection from a flat surface. Ideal for 2.5D grayscale carving. White = raised, black = recessed.
carving_traits: Good for portraits, coins, and flowing detail
Prefers smooth Z gradients and silhouette clarity
Carves well with ball nose and fine stepover
styles.machinability_prompt: Render this as a grayscale heightmap for CNC bas-relief carving. White represents raised areas, black represents recessed. Background must be flat black. Avoid lighting effects, shadows, and textures.

styles.name: High Relief
styles.description: Deeper, more dramatic projection. Edges may cast shadows. Pushes heightmaps to the limit of depth range.
carving_traits: Needs strong void separation between elements
Can require longer carve times and deeper passes
Emphasizes volumetric depth over surface detail
styles.machinability_prompt: Render as a grayscale heightmap with deep sculptural contrast. Lighter grays are raised, darker grays are deeply recessed. Avoid ambient occlusion, lighting gradients, or textured shading.

styles.name: Sunken Relief
styles.description: Designs carved inward below a flat surface. Often used for glyphs, stone engraving, or fossil-style aesthetics.
carving_traits: Requires inversion of typical heightmap logic
Works well with stylized linework or hieroglyphics
Best when background remains untouched
styles.machinability_prompt: Create a grayscale heightmap where the design is carved inward. White indicates flat surface, black is maximum depth. All carving should recess from a flat background. No shading, lighting, or color.

styles.name: Mixed Relief
styles.description: Combination of raised and recessed forms. Used in surrealism or complex scenes with dynamic depth cues.
carving_traits: Challenging to compose well in grayscale
Needs intelligent Z-mapping and transitions
Can produce striking visuals if carefully composed
styles.machinability_prompt: Generate a grayscale heightmap combining raised and recessed features. Lighter tones raise out of the surface, darker tones recess. Ensure depth transitions are clear. Avoid shadows and ambient textures.

styles.name: Linework Engraving
styles.description: Thin lines or silhouette cuts, often V-carved or used for logos and text.
carving_traits: Needs high-contrast edges and minimal gradients
Prefers clean vector-like forms
Not suitable for sculpted detail or volume
styles.machinability_prompt: Output a grayscale heightmap optimized for V-carving. Lines should be raised above a flat black background. No gradients, textures, or lighting. High contrast silhouettes preferred.

styles.name: Flat-Plane
styles.description: Bold silhouettes and minimal depth variation. Fast to carve, visually clear from a distance.
carving_traits: Great for signage or woodcut emulation
Works well with fewer Z-steps or large bits
Emphasizes shape over texture
styles.machinability_prompt: Produce a grayscale heightmap with minimal depth changes. Use clean shape edges with stepped or flat Z-values. Background must be solid black. Avoid any photoreal shading or gradients.

styles.name: Intarsia Relief
styles.description: Carving style that mimics the look of traditional intarsia woodworking — multiple flowing pieces with sharp internal edges, usually representing animals, landscapes, or figures in a puzzle-like composition. Color is implied via height variation and contour shape.
carving_traits: Sharp edge delineation between regions (like puzzle cuts)
Distinct Z-depth bands to simulate piece layering
Soft internal contours within each piece, with hard outer edges
Works best with stylized subjects: birds, mountains, animals, portraits
styles.machinability_prompt: Generate a grayscale heightmap mimicking layered wood intarsia. Regions must have strong Z-band contrast and sharp outer edges. Background is flat black. No lighting, color, or texture.
